title: Ewen McColl
html:
I qualified Bachelor of Dental Surgery from the University of Edinburgh in 1993 and on graduation was awarded the Dr Baron Ver Heyden de Lancey Memorial Award for most consistent all round graduate. Following House Officer and Senior House Officer positions in Maxillofacial Surgery, I joined the British Army as a Dental Officer in 1995. During my military career, I served as Senior Dental Officer in Afghanistan and for two years on Loan Service to The Sultan of Brunei’s Armed Forces.

After six years of General Dental Practice experience in the military, I undertook three years of Specialist Training in Periodontology at The Eastman Dental Hospital in London, passing MClinDent with distinction. Following this, I completed three years of training at Guy’s Dental Hospital in order to become an accredited Restorative Consultant. During this period, I also attended an externship in endodontics at Loma Linda University in California.

Following accreditation as a Restorative Consultant in 2009, I was then employed as a Consultant by the military, taking restorative referrals from military General Dental Practitioners. I am a GDC registered specialist in Restorative Dentistry, Periodontics, and Endodontics. My major interests are in implant dentistry, and all aspects of surgical and non-surgical periodontal therapy.

I am an Editor of the Faculty of General Dental Practitioners(now CGDent)  Standards in Dentistry and a Director of Peninsula Dental Social Enterprise. I am the current chair of Dental Schools Council, and Editorial Director of Dental Update.
